purpose: Assemble six genuine signed H4 GE19 RHS source families from the exact H3F corrected-Y Z20, H3G corrected-Y q20, certified Repair32B Z11 and original on-shell H1 on one physical x=ln(a), H(x) background. Build Stage E complete Y u+phi from action; use original frozen GE06/GE07/Lambda cross, GE05 factor-two M1 and first-order Repair26 R1 M2. Compute correct H*FD8/FD4 source Ward and retain it as diagnostic only. NO full source+operator+Euler parent Noether or Z21 state solve.
